# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >=18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build,
> gateway-specific OMP plugin, or publisher credential. Stable v0.4.0 is published as immutable
> GitHub Latest. Keep using OMP in the terminal; the separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled
> sessions and opens OMP's own encrypted View/Control client from an Android-first PWA. One-time
> setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.0, gateway installation, and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve
> with Funnel disabled. No per-session QR scan or link copy. Community project; not affiliated
> with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers.

## Current qualification boundary

- FULL signed-candidate qualification passed 2026-09-14T13:05:26.972Z; no historical transfer or claim for arbitrary builds from main.
- Exact OMP v18.1.20 source: 1bd60c6fbd0e800a75fd09b1e4804af5a5e6d63b. Set only collab.autoStart (off/view/control); start participating sessions with plain omp. The gateway reads OMP discovery and queries each host; OMP does not register with the gateway.
- Debian 13 (trixie) x86-64, Linux 6.12.94+deb13-amd64: 69/69 migration/recovery invariants, stock OMP publication/revocation, persistence, tagged-identity denial/exposure, uninstall and resource teardown.
- Mac14,3 / macOS 26.6.1 arm64: doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23, install/rotation/reboot-to-login persistence, real allowlisted identity and forged-header/exposure checks. Positive allowed-user HTTPS was measured on Mac/Pixel, not the tagged Debian CI caller.
- Pixel 10 Pro / Android 17 build CP2A.260805.005 / Chrome 152.0.7977.82: View read-only, Control writable, prompt accepted, return to directory; same-page unlock 10,398 ms, Airplane 16,821 ms, Doze 8,475 ms; all seven forbidden capability sinks detectable and clean.
- Tailscale Serve over tailnet HTTPS only, TUN mode required, Funnel disabled. Fresh relay check: 1,800 seconds, two transitions, final phase live. The founder replaced the v0.4.0 eight-hour gate with 30 minutes; eight-hour endurance was not rerun or claimed, no historical endurance transfers, and residual prolonged-operation risk is accepted. No bounded-memory-growth claim is made.
- Windows OMP, background Web Push, specialized attention and branch/resume, and new media qualification remain unqualified/unadvertised. Historical seeded-fixture media is not evidence for these lanes. Android radio changes can still wedge Chrome; the proven same-page recoveries do not remove that limit.
- v0.3.0 is the explicit fork-era migration/rollback predecessor: stopped matching-CLI uninstall/reinstall across the architecture boundary, no credential bundles. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP.
- A worker update can interrupt a pending directory-page launch: prelaunch /client/ route reservation is not implemented. This is a source-level implementation gap, not a demonstrated explanation or fix for the separate initial Control-upgrade failure.
- A separate published-byte local/Pixel smoke passed with existing OMP 18.1.21, doctor 18/18, View/Control, clean capability sinks, same-page recovery, and installed WebAPK; configuration, readiness token, and unrelated Serve mappings were preserved. This does not expand the exact candidate matrix. An initial Control-upgrade failure stopped reproducing in subsequent probes and the full smoke; its cause remains undetermined and no fix is claimed.

## Fork-era release history

- v0.3.0 requires its exact patched OMP v18.1.14 and matching historical instructions. Its qualification does not transfer to the mainline architecture.
